title: Rich ‘Karen’ Gives Police a Run For Their Money
description:
Bodycam footage shows the arrest of an Illinois businesswoman after a bizarre traffic stop in Lake Forest. Police took Vanessa Catrejon, 23, into custody after noticing a vehicle pull into and park in a parking lot after midnight. After a series of bizarre ramblings caught on body camera, including flaunting her wealth, Vanessa was escorted to the police station where she bared it all and continued berating police, to which many critics called being a "Karen." Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
